invariants.rationale: The method accesses table methods and fields without null checks, so table must be non-null.
pendingCompactionTimeline is used to check whether it contains a given instant, so it must be non-null.
operationType is compared using equals, requiring it to be non-null.
instantTime is passed to methods such as getCompactionInflightInstant, so it must be non-null.
The method throws if operationType equals LOG_COMPACT; control reaches the core logic only if this is not the case.
